profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer/Scrum Master savant in leadership and computer problem-solving techniques, with strengths of understanding, managing, and building complex systems.  Expertise in developing to enhance ServiceNow Capabilities, along with Agile frameworks and best practices to improve timely delivery of value.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
ServiceNow Developer
• Work closely with IT, Business Analysts and Product Owners to gather requirements for developing custom solutions utilizing ServiceNow, along with testing and code reviews.
• Develop and maintained functionality to satisfy business needs through the implementation of client scripts, business rules, script includes, UI Policies, UI views, fix scripts, scheduled jobs, custom service portals and system configurations.
• Organized weekly PROD Deployments and documentation for merge instructions from Dev/Test/QA/PROD.
• Lead the onboarding process for new developers and testers to include training on ServiceNow and Agile best practices.

Scrum Master
• Lead a team and coordinated daily stand-ups, sprint planning, demonstrations, retrospectives and backlog refinements resulting in on-time delivery rate of 93%
• Assisted in team development while holding teams accountable for commitments in order to leverage organizational resources to improve delivery time in an Agile team.
• Promoted empowerment of the team and encouraged a sustainable pace with high-levels of quality for the team which improved project retention.

positions.title: Brand Ambassador
positions.description:
Working for Banana Republic and worked for Old Navy. 
• Upholds a high-quality store experience for the external and internal customer.
• Supports team efforts to reduce in-store shrink activity through education, awareness and compliance.
• Assisted customers with locating merchandise.
• Provided information on products sold with-in the store.
• Set expectations for service.
• Followed all cash handling procedures per company guidelines.
• Established great customer relationships in order to achieve sales goals.

positions.title: Unarmed Security Guard Supervisor
positions.description:
Monitor networks, computer systems, applications, and environments to ensure they are running in a secure and projected manner.
Monitor car auction vehicle entry and exit while processing data describing vehicle purchase and sell information into Adesa online databases. 
Ensure networks are free of breaches for Microsoft, Equinix Data Center, and Cloud HQ

positions.title: Lead Community Organizer
positions.description:
Advocated for racial and economic justice through large-scale political education, mobilization and assisted campaigns for local, state, & federal policies to provide for a Virginia that is just and environmental sustainable. 
Developed strategies aimed at targeting and building power in working-class communities of color across the Commonwealth.
Expanded tactics aimed at targeting and retaining membership segments based on environmental and voting issues, and demographic to deepen activism and engagement among members with specific interest.

positions.title: Data Entry Clerk
positions.description:
Worked for Accrue Tax & Accounting Services which is a company who is a member of National Society of Tax Professionals.
Provided data entry and clerical assistance in Account Payable/Receivable functions.
Audited and reconciled accounts by reviewing/requesting statements, utilizing data for maintenance and invoice entry at Corporate level.
Transferred data from paper form into computer files for database systems using QuickBooks and Microsoft Office.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
Assistant Physical Education Teacher
Assist the physical education teacher in performing specific duties as assigned or
undertaking specialized tasks. 
Assist the physical education teacher in creating an environment that is conducive to
learning and appropriate to the maturity and interests of the students. 
Perform a variety of office assistance tasks such as photocopying, filing, answering
the telephone, etc. as required. 
Set up equipment for class.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science w/ Minor in Geology

educations.schoolName: The University of Virginia's College at Wise
